project.name: 知炼 EchoMind
project.goal: 从零实现一个基于 EchoMind 架构思想的知乎站内学习增强插件，在用户进入问题页后判断学习适配度，把问题、回答、作者标签、赞同数和评论反例转化为经验可信度、行动清单、自测题和错题复习卡片。
target_users: 有明确学习或成长目标但没有体系化方法的人
大学生、职场新人和自我提升用户
希望把知乎高质量回答转成行动方案的用户

success_metrics.target: A judge can complete auto trigger, action list, quiz, review card, and trace inspection within 3 minutes
Every generation returns fit_level, answer_quality_labels, experience_summary, action_items, quiz, review_cards, sources, and judge_trace
Demo uses question title, answer content, author tag, voteup count, and comment summary mock

stack_preferences: Provider interface for OpenAI official API, DeepSeek, or mock mode
constraints.budget: free/local implementation until model provider is approved
compliance: No real Zhihu account integration in MVP
Use synthetic or de-identified content only
external_services: LLM provider is a G1 decision

mvp_must_have.name: Zhihu Question Sidebar
acceptance: Show a simulated Zhihu question page with a right-side learning plugin
Automatically trigger analysis when question context is loaded and show a lightweight notification
Classify question learning fit as high, medium, or low
Use synthetic question, answer, author tag, voteup count, and comment summary data

mvp_must_have.name: Zhihu Signal And Quality
acceptance: Prioritize high-quality answers using voteup count, author tag, structure, boundary awareness, and comment challenge signals
Label answers as 优先参考, 谨慎参考, or 仅作补充
Show comment-based counterexamples as boundary reminders

mvp_must_have.name: Experience Action List
acceptance: Generate experience_summary and action_items as the primary output
Use a context-dependent number of action items instead of a fixed count
Each action item includes why_it_matters, applicable_to, check, source_ids, and confidence

mvp_must_have.name: Quiz Feedback Loop
acceptance: Generate self-test quiz from the action list and experience summary
After an incorrect answer, generate one targeted review flashcard
Keep the adjustment lightweight instead of rebuilding the full plan

mvp_must_have.name: Judge Trace
acceptance: Ordinary users see final learning results first
Judge mode shows Trigger, FitDetector, QualityRanker, CommentSynthesizer, Distiller, ActionCoach, Quiz, and Review agent steps
Trace includes source_ids, author tags, comment-based counterexamples, and uncertainty checks

retention_rules: Commit only synthetic or de-identified samples

design.accessibility_target: WCAG 2.1 AA where practical for the demo
